eps.t: The Classic Encounters of... Clive Anderson Talks Back
eps.d: Hat Trick Productions Ltd. (1993) Clive Anderson Talks Back "only the innocent or very brave survive against his razor-sharp wit..." "offbeat humour and merciless interviews......" A chance to see the best of Clive Anderson, "cuddly assassin" and fast talking host of the funniest chat show on television.

The former barrister interviews alien abductee Norman House, football manager Alan Latchley, Judge James Beauchamp and rock legend Eric Daley, all of whom bear an uncanny resemblance to comedian Peter Cook.
